$case.name: 02 Valid, with an individual party (allOf + oneOf)
$case.note: THE HEADLINE CASE. This body is 100% legal against the spec as written. `Party` declares properties {type, paymentForm, allocationPercentage} AND a oneOf pointing at IndividualParty, which is itself allOf[IndividualIdentity, PartyRelationship]. additionalProperties:false only ever looks at properties declared as its own siblings, so it rejects firstName/lastName/taxId/relationships - valid data, rejected. unevaluatedProperties:false looks at what the whole composition evaluated, so it accepts.
